Then look at the room, because a huge amount of what looks like profound psychedelic crisis is a frightened nervous system stuck in an annoying room. Dim the lights if they're too bright, and if five concerned people are talking at once, clear out all but one or two. If somebody's touching them and they don't want it, ask that person to stop, and ask before you touch them yourself. Check that they're not too hot or too cold, take them to the bathroom if they need it, and if they're trapped beside somebody they don't trust, move them.

Ask "music or quiet?" If they want music, keep it low. If a track starts pulling the experience somewhere unwanted, change it. This is a bad time to defend the playlist.

Offer water without forcing it. Sip rather than chug, since a lot of water fast is dangerous on MDMA. Speak slowly and use fewer words. Please don't explain the universe at somebody who is already frightened by it.
